WITH nationality_totals AS (
  SELECT c.nationality,
         SUM(cr.points) AS total_points,
         COUNT(*) AS constructor_entries
  FROM constructorResults AS cr
  JOIN constructors AS c ON c.constructorId = cr.constructorId
  GROUP BY c.nationality
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(constructor_entries) AS avg_entries
  FROM nationality_totals
)
SELECT nt.nationality,
       nt.total_points,
       nt.constructor_entries,
       nt.constructor_entries - overall.avg_entries AS difference_from_average
FROM nationality_totals AS nt
CROSS JOIN overall
ORDER BY nt.nationality;
